challenge.better_approach: Clearing inside cairn outlinecheck on a good run was looked at: it is codemother's command, and the trouble is the tester's (Law 6), so codemother would clear another device's trouble. The tester's own recheck at cleanup is the owner's act, in 17b087f2483f's shape.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the newest record by stamp is the latest check. Measured: stamps are YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS, so text order is time order; b7987e439273's two records sort 20261118T204848 then 20261119T093117.
challenge.prior_art: 17b087f2483f (the tester rechecks its seal kinds at cleanup) and ea354f41ec67 (the CLI wiring proof); a5be53f269ac raised the trouble.
challenge.real_collision: none: the clear rides ModuleRaiser('tester'), the trouble's own raiser, and the trouble device folds it.

answers.falsifier: Done when a trouble whose newest record ran clears through bin/cairn cleanup while one whose newest did not run stands; wrong intent if a check that ran can still leave the ticket unread.
answers.from_idea: none, because the live trouble red-tickets-outline-check-b7987e439273 (bin/cmd/trouble live) stands while CairnCommons/outline_checks/b7987e439273-20261119T093117.json reads ran True
answers.how: A third kind in cairn/devices/tester/recheck.py's recheck reading <commons>/outline_checks/<tid>-*.json as a file, and the prefix in bin/cmd/cleanup's seals step; red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cleanup_clears_an_outline_check_a_later_check_read.py.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth stays true; a trouble standing after a later check read the ticket tells the inbox reader something false.
answers.what: cairn cleanup clears the tester's red-tickets-outline-check-<tid> trouble once the newest outline-check record for that ticket reads ran True.

bullets.text: A trouble raised by a tester-run command clears by a later run only if someone rechecks; the cleanup recheck is the one place that already asks.

title: cairn cleanup clears the tester's red-tickets-outline-check-<tid> trouble once the newest outline-check record for that
